# Agent Office resident CLI monitor release

Release SHA:        273a0882d015360a771a08e5b793dfec2b48c555

This identifies the application candidate. The final RC is the release PR head
including this record. Observed main base and verified serving rollback SHA:
`a388f901d5fb2ce460f625b4438ab0b8b1dbcf24`.

Selected changes: #3020 (`8ba47f1b51a7fb7eb2f2c65a2195e954eda20f9c`) and
#3021 (`47bae92c7c76902d38a7b969730e9959a8d1f866`). Only their CLI monitor,
collector, regression checks, operator instructions and this record are selected.
The existing main state is preserved. No migration or dispatch change is included.

Owner request, 2026-10-26: connect the remaining AMUX residents to the existing
read-only CLI view. The approved scope is the existing 13 resident names.
Codex supplies structured conversations, Claude supplies its AMUX transcript,
and Cursor/Copilot supply their actual terminal viewport when AMUX has no
transcript. The panel labels the supplied format. Worker selection isolates
buffers and cancels old browser polling. Prompt bubbles and office-matched
panel height remain in place.

Final RC CI, Test SUCCESS/build-info, follow-up dev SUCCESS/build-info,
production SUCCESS/build-info, main-to-develop ancestry and production owner
UI observations are recorded in the release PR. The existing Test Cloudflare
owner-access gate remains in place. No actual CLI content is published here.

The production collector remains codex-impl-only until the app release is live.
Activation updates the existing collector's explicit 13-name selection and
bundle, preserving its ingest-only credential, public CA, separate UID and
sandbox. No worker is launched, restarted, sent a command or given new execution
authority. The same single app replica retains one bounded volatile snapshot
per worker; no transcript DB table, file or audit payload is introduced.
